scope: Static REA analysis of six selected shipped plugin contract files. Six parsed completely; 28 inventoried files excluded; application and semantic graphs partial. No host code executed by REA.

observations.finding: Panel contribution has id/title/icon/entry; its icon is documented as right-sidebar activity bar. No left-navigation placement field is exposed in this schema.
Panel CSP sets connect-src none; anchor navigation, form submissions and window.open are blocked by the wrapper.
Only workspace.readContext, terminal.sendText and notifications.show are panel-callable. Storage, secrets and settings methods are worker-only; no panel-to-worker method is exposed.
The inspected extension registry declares a command extension point.

implementationStatus: Not implemented. Browser-tab implementation or host-source extension requires a scope choice.
